# UI source attribution

The Our work pointer spotlight is adapted from the React Bits SpotlightCard pattern by David Haz.

Source: https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/tree/main/src/content/Components/SpotlightCard

Changes: link-based cards, local pointer events, restrained orange light, gentle card tilt, touch and reduced-motion handling. No package dependency was added. The supplied license is in react-bits-license.txt and embedded in the generated bundle.
